# Mahalaxmi Fashion Hub

> A family-run ethnic and fashion wear shop in Balotra, Rajasthan, India, selling online across India.
> We stock cotton nighties, sarees, petticoats, women's innerwear, kurtis, men's formal shoes and perfume.
> Cash on Delivery is available everywhere in India. Shipping is free above Rs. 999 and a flat Rs. 60 below that.
> Orders are dispatched in 1-2 business days via Delhivery and most arrive within 4-10 business days of being placed.
> Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for damaged, defective, wrong or missing items, with an
> unedited parcel-opening video; change of mind and size issues are not covered.

A longer, always-current version of this file, listing live categories and product counts, is at
https://www.mahalaxmifashionhub.com/llms-full.txt

## Shop
- Name: Mahalaxmi Fashion Hub
- Address: Ward No. 45, Near Mahadev Temple, Balotra, Rajasthan 344022, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9429429880
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM IST
- Languages: Hindi, English
- Payment: Cash on Delivery, UPI, debit card, credit card, net banking
- Sizes: S to XXL for readymade clothing; some pieces are Free Size
